verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs index lists first-party pages on assigning external entity IDs retroactively, supporting multiple external entity IDs, and entity merging. That points to documented customer/entity reconciliation by stable external identifiers, but the evidence is only page titles with no detail. Missing for 10: any evidence that case/investigation records carry or reconcile on external identifiers, substantive documentation of how external ID assignment and merging behave, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
